newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Polkomtel mobile phone firm to up capital.
newsitem.headline: Polish Polkomtel mobile phone firm to up capital.

text.p: Polkomtel SA, one of Poland's two digital cellular telephone operators, wants to approve a 200 million zloty, or 37 percent, increase of its share capital at its next shareholders' meeting on February 27, it said on Friday.
Polkomtel spokesman Leszek Kaminski said that the increase was part of the international consortium's long-term strategy.
"The capital increase is conntected to the long-term strategy of increasing the value of the firm, and will be covered entirely by existing shareholders," he told Reuters.
Kaminski said Polkomtel's Plus GSM mobile phone network, launched last October, may have more than 200,000 subscribers by the end of the year after ending 1996 with 50,000 clients.
"If the fast growth rate continues. Plus GSM can have more than 200,000 clients by the end of the year," Kaminski said.
Polkomtel groups Danish Tele Danmark, U.S. AirTouch Communications, Polish copper concern KGHM SA, the Plock oil refinery and the National Power Grid (PSE).
